formal_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (G : SimpleGraph (Fin (N + N))) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ u v : Fin (N + N), G.Adj u v ↔ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ ((u = Fin.castAdd N p ∧ v = Fin.natAdd N l) ∨ (u = Fin.natAdd N l ∧ v = Fin.castAdd N p))) → PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (N + N) C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) C = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ → PEqualNP.Core.IsLiftFixedPoint G C → (∀ k < C.gates.length, PEqualNP.Core.InOutputCone (N + N) C k) → (∀ k2 < C.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C k2).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∀ t ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C k2).inputs, ¬ (∀ x : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨C.gates, t⟩ (List.ofFn x) = true → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ x = true)) → ∀ p1 l1 : Fin N, (p1.val, N + l1.val) ∈ (PEqualNP.ReadK.doubleReread C (N + N) (fun w => decide (N ≤ w)) ((List.finRange N).flatMap (fun p5 => ((List.finRange N).filter (fun l5 => decide (I p5 l5))).map (fun l6 => (p5.val, N + l6.val))))) → ∃ j ∈ PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C, s(Fin.castAdd N p1, Fin.natAdd N l1) ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.gammaE G C j
plain_statement: G: bipartite, N points, N lines as inputs, no 4-cycle. C: AND and OR gates, each reading exactly two earlier wires, computing G's edge function F; every gate in the output's cone; no OR of that cone not below F reads a wire below F and true somewhere; no AND reads a wire below F. Then each edge (p, l) where no proof tree of the output on x_p, y_l reads y_l once and none reads x_p once is true on x_p, y_l alone at a maximal core: a gate below F, not reading two such gates, in no core's cone, every proof tree of some edge it accepts reading an end twice.
title: No-4-cycle incidence, lift-fixed AND/OR fan-in-2 circuit, no dead gate, no AND reading a below-F wire: double re-read edges lie at maximal cores
